mentions.name: Ori
mentions.description: An open-source agentic IoT runtime built around a Physical Actuation Trust framework, in which AI agents acting in the physical world must formally earn the authority to act, tier by tier, from informational alerts up to safety-critical relay control. It runs offline on a $55 Raspberry Pi, with first deployments underway in Lagos.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Building Ori, an open-source agentic IoT runtime with a Physical Actuation Trust framework.

The core idea: every AI agent acting in the physical world must formally earn the authority to act, tier by tier, from informational alerts through to safety-critical relay control. Runs offline on a $55 Pi.
